data.narrative:
Iambic Therapeutics is a Series B biotech company that has raised $350M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 4 private peers in the Biotech & Health sector at Series B/C stages (Eikon Therapeutics, Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, New Limit) and 3 public biotech comps (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L).

Two quantitative methods are applicable. Stage-Progression analysis applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier to the $350M raised proxy, implying a $665M valuation. Peer-Median analysis across the 4 same-sector comparables yields a median valuation of $3.5B, with a wide range of $539M to $10.3B reflecting heterogeneity in the peer set. Public-Comp anchoring via P/S multiples (sector median 5.6x) cannot be applied without disclosed revenue figures. These two methods triangulate to a range of $565M (low) to $4.0B (high), with a median implied valuation of $2.1B.

The wide spread reflects material uncertainty in stage-appropriate valuation for a Series B biotech. The Stage-Progression method suggests more conservative positioning; the Peer-Median skews higher, driven by later-stage Series C comparables commanding $3.1B–$10.3B valuations. Without revenue visibility or clarity on clinical stage and IP strength relative to peers, the $2.1B median should be treated as a central estimate rather than a point value.
